    "foreign_build_reasons": sorted({cell["reason"] for cell in refused["cells"]}),
    "rung_768_first_cell_reason": decide(table, 768)["cells"][0]["reason"],

print("MENU_READOUT " + json.dumps(readout, sort_keys=True))

[ $rc_env -eq 0 ] && [ $rc_policy -eq 0 ] && [ $rc_collect -eq 0 ] && [ $rc_readout -eq 0 ]'

actions.name: probe
actions.command:
/bin/bash -c 'set +e
IMG=localhost/prismaquant/spark-vllm-nccl230@sha256:c2e75e03cfc52c15489b40fe58e65acb7347f6fa3ddf2e81afda86760698147b
WIRES=/mnt/shared/astra-native-a4/data
echo "HOST $(hostname)"
echo "IMAGE_INSPECT $(docker image inspect "$IMG" --format '"'"'{{.Id}} {{json .RepoDigests}} created={{.Created}}'"'"' 2>&1)"
PROBE=$(cat <<'"'"'PYEOF'"'"'
import importlib.metadata as m, json, sys
out = {"python": sys.version.split()[0]}
for name in ("torch", "triton", "tokenspeed-triton", "tokenspeed_triton", "vllm", "numpy", "jsonschema"):
    try:
        out[name] = m.version(name)
    except m.PackageNotFoundError:
        out[name] = None
import torch
out["torch_cuda"] = torch.version.cuda
out["device"] = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
out["capability"] = list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0))
import tessera.kernel_a4 as kernel_a4
out["backend"] = kernel_a4.native_fp4_backend()
out["backend_module_version"] = getattr(kernel_a4._TRITON, "__version__", None)
out["ptx_tokens"] = kernel_a4.native_fp4_mma_ptx_tokens()
print("IDENTITY " + json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
PYEOF
)
docker run --rm --gpus all --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --entrypoint /usr/bin/python3 \
  --workdir "$PWD" --mount "type=bind,src=$PWD,dst=$PWD,readonly" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$WIRES,dst=$WIRES,readonly" \
  --env "PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src" --env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --env HOME=/tmp --env TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/triton \
  --env "TESSERA_A4_WIRE_DIR=$WIRES" --env "PRISMABUILD_CONTAINER_OWNER=$PRISMABUILD_CONTAINER_OWNER" \
  "$IMG" -c "$PROBE"
rc=$?
echo "PROBE_RC $rc"
exit $rc'
